## 🌎 Geopolitics

### Iran Demands War Reparations to Reopen Hormuz as US Signals Munitions Concerns

Iran's parliament is reviewing legislation to ban U.S. and Israeli ships from the Strait of Hormuz and impose tolls on other traffic until Tehran receives compensation for war damage from the five-month conflict. Negotiations with Oman on a commercial shipping framework continue, but Iran denies direct talks with Washington. President Trump privately expressed concern that Pentagon munitions stockpile depletion undermines U.S. negotiating leverage, though publicly claimed massive ammunition reserves as Saudi Arabia braces for coordinated militia and Houthi attacks.

**Why it matters.** For India, Hormuz's closure directly threatens energy security—roughly 30% of seaborne crude oil transits the strait, and India is among the world's largest oil importers. A prolonged blockade would spike import costs precisely when the rupee faces pressure and energy inflation compounds manufacturing costs for consulting clients and quant strategies exposed to commodity volatility. The geopolitical bargaining game between Tehran and Washington also reshapes the calculus for India's crude-purchase diplomacy, forcing tighter engagement with alternative suppliers.

**Action.** Track the Hormuz Strait closure timeline via Reuters commodity alerts and shipping intelligence platforms (Equinor, Vortexa); watch Brent crude and Indian refining margin compression. Monitor Iran's formal stance through Ministry of Foreign Affairs statements via MEED or official Iranian news agencies. Assess corporate energy hedging costs if transport premiums persist beyond Q3 2026.

*Sources: [npr.org](https://www.npr.org/2026/08/06/nx-s1-5923623/iran-strait-hormuz-us-israel-ban) · [cnn.com](https://www.cnn.com/2026/08/06/world/live-news/iran-war-trump) · [cnn.com](https://www.cnn.com/2026/08/04/world/live-news/iran-war-trump)*

### Ukraine Sustains Drone Defense as Russia Escalates Infrastructure Strikes Ahead of Zelensky's Serbia Outreach

Russia launched 147 Shahed-type drones against Ukrainian targets on the night of August 7, with Ukrainian air defenses intercepting 114 in one of the conflict's ongoing attrition cycles. Strikes killed at least six civilians across Kharkiv, Dnipropetrovsk, and Donetsk regions; Ukraine retaliated with strikes on Russian military infrastructure in occupied Crimea and a logistics hub in Wildberries nearly 2,000 kilometers from the front line. President Zelensky is set to visit Serbia on August 8, signaling diplomatic engagement with a NATO-adjacent state amid frozen-conflict dynamics.

**Why it matters.** Ukraine's strategy of targeting deep Russian economic infrastructure (e-commerce, energy supply chains) mirrors tactics relevant to supply-chain resilience discussions—sustained attrition of production capacity outside direct combat zones. The durability of Ukraine's air defense and offensive reach also frames risk for any India-linked sectors dependent on European manufacturing or energy inputs. Zelensky's Serbia visit reflects efforts to maintain diplomatic bandwidth as the conflict settles into defensive postures; this shapes medium-term Western commitment calculus.

**Action.** Monitor Ukrainian drone production capacity and ATACMS availability through defense publications (CSIS, ISW daily updates); track Wildberries and Havarti damage assessments for business continuity signals. Assess whether the Serbia visit signals momentum toward negotiated settlement or consolidation of current lines—key for long-term European energy and manufacturing outlook.

*Sources: [aljazeera.com](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/8/7/several-killed-in-attacks-on-ukraine-as-kyiv-hits-russian-e-commerce-giant) · [kyivindependent.com](https://kyivindependent.com/tag/war/) · [en.wikipedia.org](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Timeline_of_the_Russo-Ukrainian_war_(1_January_2026_%E2%80%93_present))*

## 🧠 Artificial Intelligence

### Claude Mythos 5 Hits 83.04 on BenchAlign, Setting Frontier Baseline for August

Claude Mythos 5, Anthropic's proprietary frontier model, scores 83.04/100 on BenchAlign as of August 7, 2026—ranking first among 216 tracked models. With a 1M context window and explicit reasoning mode, it edges Claude Fable 5 (82.79) and Claude Opus 5 (82.59). The model is currently restricted to Glasswing partners and trusted-access programs.

**Why it matters.** For engineers building agentic systems or evaluating frontier capabilities, this benchmark establishes the performance ceiling—Mythos's explicit reasoning mode trades inference latency for correctness on complex problem-solving tasks, a tradeoff that matters for RAG pipelines, long-context retrieval, and multi-step reasoning workloads. The 1M context window means enterprise applications can now pass full document codebases or year-long chat histories into a single inference call without chunking. If you're deciding between closed-source APIs for production deployment, this is the measured capability to beat.

**Action.** Request access through Anthropic's Glasswing program to run domain-specific benchmarks—standard evals don't capture latency-accuracy tradeoffs for your workload. If you're locked into GPT-5.6, audit your reasoning tasks to see if they justify Mythos's inference cost. Benchmark your prompt chains against the 83.04 baseline; if you're below 81, re-evaluate your architecture.

*Sources: [[https://benchlm.ai/models/claude-mythos-5](https://benchlm.ai/models/claude-mythos-5)]([https://benchlm.ai/models/claude-mythos-5](https://benchlm.ai/models/claude-mythos-5)) · [[https://www.anthropic.com/news/claude-fable-5-mythos-5](https://www.anthropic.com/news/claude-fable-5-mythos-5)]([https://www.anthropic.com/news/claude-fable-5-mythos-5](https://www.anthropic.com/news/claude-fable-5-mythos-5)) · [[https://www.vellum.ai/blog/claude-fable-5-and-mythos-5-benchmarks-explained](https://www.vellum.ai/blog/claude-fable-5-and-mythos-5-benchmarks-explained)]([https://www.vellum.ai/blog/claude-fable-5-and-mythos-5-benchmarks-explained](https://www.vellum.ai/blog/claude-fable-5-and-mythos-5-benchmarks-explained))*

### Google DeepMind Centralizes Under Kavukcuoglu; Hassabis Moves to Chairman Role

Koray Kavukcuoglu takes over day-to-day leadership of Google DeepMind as Senior VP, reporting directly to CEO Sundar Pichai, effective August 6, 2026. Demis Hassabis transitions to Chair and Chief Scientist of Alphabet, stepping back from operational duties. Kavukcuoglu, who has spent 13 years at DeepMind and founded its deep learning team, now owns Gemini development, frontier research, and the developer platform.

**Why it matters.** This restructuring ends the Brain/DeepMind continental split that has fragmented Google's research coordination since 2023. With Kavukcuoglu centralizing operations at Mountain View and Hassabis freed to advise on long-horizon strategy, Google is shifting from researcher-led autonomy to operationally-focused model development. For infrastructure decisions, this consolidation likely accelerates Gemini's roadmap and tightens feedback loops between researchers and production systems—watch for faster model iteration and clearer product alignment. Competitors like Anthropic and OpenAI have tighter chains of command; this move puts Google back on par.

**Action.** If you've been waiting for stable Gemini API contracts or production readiness, Kavukcuoglu's ops background suggests speedier execution. Monitor Google DeepMind's announcements for Gemini 4 timelines—leadership changes precede major releases. If you're recruiting from DeepMind, expect higher attrition as Hassabis's advisory role creates ambiguity on individual contributor direction.

*Sources: [[https://www.edtechinnovationhub.com/news/e6jbqlsiv0bte7hruv5sgk6z41k29e](https://www.edtechinnovationhub.com/news/e6jbqlsiv0bte7hruv5sgk6z41k29e)]([https://www.edtechinnovationhub.com/news/e6jbqlsiv0bte7hruv5sgk6z41k29e](https://www.edtechinnovationhub.com/news/e6jbqlsiv0bte7hruv5sgk6z41k29e)) · [[https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-08-06/google-shifts-ai-power-to-california-in-race-against-anthropic-openai](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-08-06/google-shifts-ai-power-to-california-in-race-against-anthropic-openai)]([https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-08-06/google-shifts-ai-power-to-california-in-race-against-anthropic-openai](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-08-06/google-shifts-ai-power-to-california-in-race-against-anthropic-openai)) · [[https://nokiapoweruser.com/google-deepmind-leadership-demis-hassabis-koray-kavukcuoglu/](https://nokiapoweruser.com/google-deepmind-leadership-demis-hassabis-koray-kavukcuoglu/)]([https://nokiapoweruser.com/google-deepmind-leadership-demis-hassabis-koray-kavukcuoglu/](https://nokiapoweruser.com/google-deepmind-leadership-demis-hassabis-koray-kavukcuoglu/))*

## 🇮🇳 India

### Leap India Launches ₹2,480 Crore IPO After ₹371 Crore Pre-IPO Round, Supply Chain Tech Eyes Public Markets

Leap India, a supply chain and asset-pooling platform incorporated in 2013, opened its ₹2,480 crore IPO for subscription on August 7, 2026, with listing expected August 14. The company raised ₹371.3 crore in pre-IPO placements led by GIC's subsidiary Gamnat Pte Ltd (₹280 crore) and Dymon Asia Multi-Strategy Investment (₹50 crore). The IPO price band is ₹151–₹159 per share, comprising ₹480 crore fresh issuance and ₹2,000 crore offer for sale.

**Why it matters.** For engineers building logistics, supply chain, or inventory-optimization systems in India, Leap's public listing validates the market for asset-pooling and returnable packaging platforms at scale. The company serves e-commerce, FMCG, automotive, and consumer durables — sectors AI engineers are increasingly helping optimize through demand forecasting, route optimization, and inventory ML. Leap's IPO path shows institutional appetite for infrastructure tech and demonstrates a viable exit for founders. The pre-IPO participation by sovereign wealth funds signals global confidence in India's logistics infrastructure plays.

**Action.** Track Leap India's IPO allotment (Aug 12) and listing (Aug 14) via NSE/BSE. Review the company's prospectus filing for AI/ML usage in their current product stack. Monitor post-listing financial performance to understand how Indian public markets value logistics-tech operators — this sets benchmarks for other supply chain startups planning exits.

*Sources: [ipowatch.in](https://ipowatch.in/leap-india-ipo/) · [indiaipo.in](https://www.indiaipo.in/ipo-blogs/leap-india-ipo) · [startuptalky.com](https://startuptalky.com/news/daily-indian-funding-roundup-key-news-6-august-2026/)*

### BlissClub Closes ₹160 Crore Series B as Domestic VCs Double Down on D2C Fitness

D2C fitness and apparel platform BlissClub raised ₹160 crore in Series B funding on August 7, 2026, led by Singularity AMC with backing from founders Minu Margeret and Vidit Aatrey who invested personal capital. Existing investors Elevation Capital and Eight Roads Ventures increased commitments, signaling founder-investor alignment as the platform scales.

**Why it matters.** For AI engineers considering fintech, healthcare, or consumer-tech roles in India, BlissClub's round size and investor quality demonstrates that domestic venture capital is rotating toward consumer technology and lifestyle startups post-2025. The founders' personal capital injection indicates confidence in margins and profitability, a shift from the high-burn models of the early 2020s. This shapes hiring and product priorities: investors now expect ML-driven personalization (workout recommendations, retention modeling) to drive unit economics and engagement metrics. The round size also signals that mid-market consumer tech can compete with enterprise software for capital.

**Action.** Review BlissClub's product roadmap for AI/personalization features (if public). Research Singularity AMC's investment thesis to understand which consumer-tech subsectors are attracting institutional capital. Monitor Series B closures in fitness, health, and D2C categories this quarter to gauge domestic VC appetite for consumer segments — this informs whether competing startups can raise similar cheques.

*Sources: [startuptalky.com](https://startuptalky.com/news/daily-indian-funding-roundup-key-news-7-august-2026/) · [yourstory.com](https://yourstory.com/2026/08/startup-news-and-updates-daily-roundup-august-7-2026)*

## 📈 Markets

### Divergence widens as US rides dovish pivot while India battles food-fuel inflation

The S&P 500 surged to 7,757.64 (+0.62%), Nasdaq climbed 1.3% to 26,690.62, and the Dow added 151.83 points (+0.28%) on July's unexpected US jobs loss, signaling the Fed can hold rates steady. Meanwhile, Nifty 50 slipped to 24,570.65 (−0.27%), Sensex fell 455.59 points to 78,499.17 (−0.58%), and Bank Nifty dropped 317.20 points to 57,746.45 (−0.55%). Brent crude fell to $82.15/barrel (−0.41%) but gold surged to $4,401.30, up 2.37% to a seven-week peak. The rupee weakened to 95.10 against the dollar.

**Why it matters.** The split reveals how differently central banks are viewing inflation. The Fed can now signal a pause or cuts as US labour softens; markets are pricing in rate stability and buying equities with abandon. India's RBI, by contrast, kept the repo rate at 5.25% and repeatedly cited food and fuel pushing headline inflation to uncomfortable levels—the committee wants clarity before moving. This creates carry headwinds for rupee assets: the Fed-RBI wedge widens, foreign capital flows to dollar strength, and Indian financials (which saw outsized selling today) face a regime where deposit costs stay sticky while lending volumes remain under pressure from capex uncertainty. Geopolitical risk in the West Asia region—supply disruptions threatening oil transit through the Strait of Hormuz—adds a tail-risk premium to crude, keeping domestic inflation fears alive.

**Action.** Watch for the weekly oil inventory data due tonight (US time) and any further commentary from RBI Governor Malhotra on whether food inflation is expected to persist through Q2. If Brent breaks below $80, India's fiscal space improves and rate-cut odds rise; if it rallies past $85 on Middle East escalation, the RBI will likely stay hawkish. Monitor the Nifty 50's 24,500 support—a break below would signal institutional capitulation and set the stage for a deeper repricing of rate expectations.

### Gold rallies to 7-week high while rupee weakens; financials absorb the rate-hold shock

Gold broke through to $4,401.30 per troy ounce, its highest in seven weeks and up 2.37% on the day, as investors shunned risk after July's US jobs disappointment signaled the Fed would not tighten. The rupee simultaneously depreciated to 95.10 per dollar, surrendering gains to a stronger greenback and elevated crude premiums. Bank Nifty bore the brunt of this repricing, falling 0.55% and underperforming the broader Nifty 50's 0.27% decline, signaling that the rate-hold narrative hit financial equities hardest.

**Why it matters.** Gold's rally and rupee weakness are two sides of the same coin: weaker US rates and geopolitical unease (Middle East strait tensions, supply disruption fears) bid up safe havens while pushing capital toward the dollar. For Indian quant and prop desks, this intraday divergence in gold-rupee (typically correlated on RBI policy moves) signals a shift from domestic rate narratives toward global risk-off sentiment. The outsized damage to Bank Nifty (financial index down 55 bps vs Nifty down 27 bps) shows that institutional money is repricing duration risk—if RBI holds while the Fed eases, deposit spreads compress and loan growth becomes harder to justify at current valuations. This is a subtle but critical tell for relative-value pairs traders and liquidity-sensitive long-short strategies.

**Action.** Monitor gold-rupee correlation through the London and New York sessions today. If gold breaks $4,420 (resistance) and the rupee pushes past 95.20, expect further outflows from Indian equities into dollar-denominated assets and a widening of the RBI-Fed rate differential risk premium. Watch for any RBI forward guidance on the rupee or capital flows in official statements; a weaker rupee fed by external imbalances could force an earlier policy pivot than the August hold suggests.

## 🇮🇳 Indian Stocks

### SBI (NSE): +3.6% on Q1 beat; net profit ₹21,121 crore

State Bank of India surged to an intraday high of ₹1,124.50 on August 7, gaining 3.6% from the previous close of ₹1,085.00 after announcing Q1 FY27 results that beat market estimates. Net profit jumped to ₹21,121 crore, up 10% year-on-year and above consensus of ₹19,052 crore, driven by net interest income growth of 14.88% to ₹46,992 crore. Trading volumes were elevated as institutional investors responded to improved metrics across profitability, asset quality, and margins.

**Why it matters.** SBI's outperformance signals strength in India's domestic banking franchise ahead of a potential rate-cut cycle. The lender's lowest NPA ratios in over two decades and 18.63% advances growth reflect disciplined credit underwriting during a maturing credit cycle. For Indian tech professionals watching capital markets, this validates the banking sector's earnings resilience and suggests PSU bank valuations may have further room despite recent strength. The beat underscores India's credit expansion story—companies are still borrowing, banks are collecting, and spreads remain healthy.

**Action.** Check SBI's investor relations portal for the detailed results release and management commentary on deposit mix and domestic NIM guidance. The domestic net interest margin at 3% offers a key level to monitor; any compression in future quarters could signal margin pressure. Watch for analyst upgrades on SBI following this quarter; consensus estimates may move higher, potentially driving the stock toward ₹1,150 resistance.

*Sources: [[SBI Q1 Results on Upstox](https://upstox.com/news/market-news/stocks/state-bank-of-india-shares-soar-3-following-q1-results-check-net-profit-nii-and-key-highlights/article-198314/)]([SBI Q1 Results on Upstox](https://upstox.com/news/market-news/stocks/state-bank-of-india-shares-soar-3-following-q1-results-check-net-profit-nii-and-key-highlights/article-198314/)) · [[Bloomberg: SBI Earnings Beat Estimates](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-08-07/india-s-top-bank-net-income-beats-estimates-aided-by-loan-growth)]([Bloomberg: SBI Earnings Beat Estimates](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-08-07/india-s-top-bank-net-income-beats-estimates-aided-by-loan-growth)) · [[SBI Official Board Announcement](https://www.sahi.com/news/state-bank-of-india-to-review-first-quarter-results-on-august-7-589-PE1_CORP)]([SBI Official Board Announcement](https://www.sahi.com/news/state-bank-of-india-to-review-first-quarter-results-on-august-7-589-PE1_CORP))*

### POWERGRID (NSE): -3.9% on flat Q1 earnings; biggest Sensex laggard

Power Grid Corporation shares dropped to ₹270.75 on August 6, declining 3.9% from the previous close of ₹281.75 after reporting Q1 FY27 results that disappointed the market. Consolidated net profit slipped marginally to ₹3,598 crore, down 0.8% year-on-year and down 20.85% sequentially from ₹4,546 crore in Q4 FY26, signaling weakness in the utility's seasonal earnings pattern. The stock was the worst performer in both the Nifty 50 and Sensex indices, eroding the company's market capitalization by ₹10,463 crore.

**Why it matters.** Power Grid's flat earnings trajectory raises questions about capital expenditure productivity in India's transmission network. While the company continues transmission expansion, the earnings miss suggests either delayed project completions or margin compression in core operations—both concerning for a quasi-government utility with limited pricing flexibility. For investors tracking India's infrastructure capex cycle, this signals that transmission developers face headwinds despite government push for grid modernization; read-across to peers like Adani Green and renewable majors watching power evacuation timelines.

**Action.** Request Power Grid's detailed quarterly report filing on the NSE disclosures platform to break down the sequential decline—is it seasonal working capital outflows, delayed revenue recognition, or operational cost inflation? Look for management's capex guidance update; the company approved ₹856.94 crore in investments, but monitor whether execution improves Q2 collections. Support level now at ₹270; a close below ₹265 would signal further institutional selling.

*Sources: [[Power Grid Q1 Results on Upstox](https://upstox.com/news/market-news/stocks/power-grid-corp-shares-drop-4-after-flat-q1-performance-capex-growth-potential-ahead/article-198215/)]([Power Grid Q1 Results on Upstox](https://upstox.com/news/market-news/stocks/power-grid-corp-shares-drop-4-after-flat-q1-performance-capex-growth-potential-ahead/article-198215/)) · [[Business Standard: Q1 Profit Slips](https://www.business-standard.com/markets/capital-market-news/power-grid-declines-after-q1-pat-drops-21-qoq-to-rs-3-598-crore-126080601032_1.html)]([Business Standard: Q1 Profit Slips](https://www.business-standard.com/markets/capital-market-news/power-grid-declines-after-q1-pat-drops-21-qoq-to-rs-3-598-crore-126080601032_1.html)) · [[NSE POWERGRID Official Quotes](https://www.nseindia.com/get-quotes/equity?symbol=POWERGRID)]([NSE POWERGRID Official Quotes](https://www.nseindia.com/get-quotes/equity?symbol=POWERGRID))*

## 💹 Global Stocks

### TSM (NYSE): +1.1% on raised 2026 revenue guidance, $60B+ capex bet on 2nm

Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company (TSM) closed at $422.82 on August 7, 2026, up 1.1% from the prior $418.20 close, following earnings that lifted full-year revenue growth guidance to slightly above 40% from prior guidance of 30%-plus. The company raised capital expenditure outlook to $60 billion–$64 billion (a jump of $8 billion at the midpoint) and guided Q3 2026 revenue of $44.6 billion–$45.8 billion—a record—anchored by steep ramp-up of its 2-nanometer process. Net income surged 77.4% year-over-year in Q2, with diluted EPS of NT$27.25 (approximately $0.87).

**Why it matters.** TSMC's capex surge and 2nm ramp acceleration signal that AI chip demand is durable enough to justify $4 billion more in factory investment, directly validating the supply-side thesis underpinning semis stocks. The company's 40%+ revenue growth and record gross margins on AI utilization set a floor for foundry capacity tightness through 2026–2027, with direct read-across to peers (Samsung, SK Hynix) and equipment vendors (ASML, LRCX). For AI investors, TSMC's 2nm lead is the bottleneck: Nvidia, AMD, and custom AI chip designers rely on TSMC capacity. The company announced an additional $100 billion commitment to Arizona manufacturing, signaling conviction in secular AI demand outside Taiwan.

**Action.** Monitor Q3 2026 earnings call (scheduled late October 2026) for utilization rates, 2nm yield ramp commentary, and customer concentration risk. Watch TSMC's next capex guidance in January 2027; any flat or downward revision signals demand normalization. Track ASP (average selling price) trends in the earnings transcript—if 2nm pricing shows compression, foundry margin risk emerges. Reference SEC Form 6-K filings for detailed revenue mix by process node.

*Sources: [[TSMC Q2 2026 earnings and guidance](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/tsmc-q2-2026-earnings-record-112109987.html)]([TSMC Q2 2026 earnings and guidance](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/tsmc-q2-2026-earnings-record-112109987.html)) · [[TSMC raises capex and revenue forecast](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/article/tsmc-raises-capex-and-revenue-forecast-highlighting-growing-ai-chip-demand-113101950.html)]([TSMC raises capex and revenue forecast](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/article/tsmc-raises-capex-and-revenue-forecast-highlighting-growing-ai-chip-demand-113101950.html)) · [[Earnings transcript and 2nm guidance](https://www.investing.com/news/transcripts/earnings-call-transcript-tsmc-lifts-2026-outlook-as-ai-demand-stays-hot-in-q2-2026-93CH-4635181)]([Earnings transcript and 2nm guidance](https://www.investing.com/news/transcripts/earnings-call-transcript-tsmc-lifts-2026-outlook-as-ai-demand-stays-hot-in-q2-2026-93CH-4635181))*

### ASML (Euronext): Raised full-year 2026 revenue guidance €43B–€45B on AI equipment orders surge

ASML Holding NV (Euronext: ASML), the world's dominant EUV lithography supplier, raised full-year 2026 revenue guidance to €43 billion–€45 billion from prior guidance of €36 billion–€40 billion, and lifted gross margin outlook to 54%–56% full-year. The upgrade followed Q2 2026 net sales of €9.3 billion on 55%–57% gross margin. Q3 guidance of €11.0 billion–€12.0 billion reflects strong bookings for advanced chipmaking equipment driven by AI infrastructure buildout; the company also raised full-year 2026 earnings guidance commensurately.

**Why it matters.** ASML's 8%+ revenue raise (to €44.5B midpoint, from €38B prior) is the clearest signal that semis capex intensity for AI is genuine and multi-year, not transient. The company is bottlenecked on delivery capacity for High-NA EUV tools, which Intel and TSMC now use for cutting-edge logic. ASML's margin expansion despite supply constraints reflects pricing power—customers will pay premium for early access to 2nm/3nm node capacity. The milestone achievement of Intel Foundry shipping the first high-volume logic product on High-NA EUV validates the technology roadmap and gives ASML confidence in 2027 order flow. This directly enables TSMC, Samsung, and Intel capex cycles.

**Action.** Monitor ASML's Q3 2026 earnings (expected late October 2026) for order backlog trends and geography mix—especially exposure to China restrictions under ECRA rules. Watch for customer concentration risk: if TSMC + Samsung account for >60% of orders, supply disruptions to one customer cascade. Track gross margin trajectory—any compression below 53% signals input cost inflation or competitive pricing pressure. Reference SEC Form 20-F and Euronext announcements for capex guidance.

### Ultrasound Wearable Cuts REM Sleep Latency by 43 Minutes in First Human Trial

University of Texas at Austin researchers developed NEUSLeeP, a skin-attached ultrasound patch that stimulates deep brain regions to enhance REM sleep without medication or surgery. In 28 participants, the device shortened time to REM sleep by 43 minutes and extended REM duration by approximately 16 minutes on average. Users reported minimal adverse effects and high comfort. The findings, published in Nature Communications on August 6, suggest therapeutic potential for PTSD, depression, and chronic insomnia through neurobiological pathways that support emotional regulation.

**Why it matters.** REM sleep is the brain's emotional reset cycle—critical for stress adaptation and mood stability. A 43-minute acceleration represents a clinically meaningful threshold for clinical sleep disorders and psychiatric conditions. For AI-in-health builders, this validates noninvasive neuromodulation through wearable form factors, opening markets in precision sleep medicine and digital therapeutics for mood disorders. The device-as-therapy model sidesteps pharmaceutical pathways and scales to millions of users. The non-invasive nature and measurable biomarkers (heart rate variability, fMRI-confirmed brain circuit changes) make this actionable for direct-to-consumer and clinical deployment within 2-3 years.

**Action.** Read the Nature Communications paper (DOI: 10.1038/s41467-026-73787-6) for full electrophysiology data. ### Blocking Glycine Transporter Restores Brain Signaling in Adult Autism Models

Eunjoon Kim's team at the IBS Center for Synaptic Brain Dysfunctions used antisense oligonucleotides (ASOs) to reduce SLC6A20, a glycine transporter expressed in cortex and hippocampus. In mice carrying SHANK2 or SHANK3 mutations—major autism risk factors also linked to Phelan-McDermid syndrome—the treatment restored NMDA receptor function and improved social interaction, social communication, and repetitive behaviors. Effects persisted for eight weeks post-treatment. Human cortical organoids with the same mutations showed identical NMDAR restoration, suggesting translational viability.

**Why it matters.** This challenges the developmental critical-period dogma by showing the adult brain retains plasticity for NMDAR-rescue therapies. SHANK mutations are high-confidence genetic hits in autism spectrum disorder, Phelan-McDermid, and other neurodevelopmental conditions—a multibillion-dollar clinical space. The ASO platform is proven in clinics (spinraza, ionis) and enables genotype-first therapy: patients can be stratified by mutation status and enrolled into targeted trials. This unlocks patient-level precision in neurodevelopmental medicine and reduces trial heterogeneity—two major barriers to autism therapeutics.

**Action.** Obtain the full Nature Communications paper (published August 5, 2026, lead author Eunjoon Kim) to extract NMDAR rescue metrics and organoid kinetics. This positions SLC6A20 as a licensing target for ASO biotech firms. Launch a genotyping collaboration with autism cohorts to identify SHANK-mutant carriers for future trials. The 8-week durability data justifies a Phase I trial design; contact IBS Center or collaborating institutions (South Korea, likely) for partnership discussions.
